title: Trigger Pad Service State
description: A grid of assignable buttons; pressing a pad sends its configured payload into the pipeline. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/trigger-pad)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

padAssignments.description: Map of pad index → payload to emit

armedPad.description: Index of the currently active/armed pad

\"trigger-pad\".description: Fire the payload of the specified pad

\"clear-pad\".description: Remove the payload assignment for a pad
